title: Emotionally Vulnerable Subtype of Internet Gaming Disorder: Measuring and Exploring the Pathology of Problematic Generative AI Use
reasoning: The paper's primary objective is the development and validation of the PUGenAIS-9 scale to measure addiction-like symptoms in users of Generative AI. Although it incorporates 'Ethical Competence' and 'Benevolence and Integrity' as auxiliary variables for correlation analysis, the research does not focus on evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics as its main component.
